subject: shiny app disconnects from server; no logs

messages.author: 254b8ed5c8f29dfa
messages.subject: shiny app disconnects from server; no logs
parts:
Hi all,

I have a private app at https://proxe.shinyapps.io/PRoXe/ that is disconnecting from server after minimal use (switching tabPanel, filtering a DT dataframe factor variable, have not exhausted this search). It runs just fine locally. My old version at a different URL works just fine at shinyapps.io.

The other odd thing is that I see *no new logs* after yesterday. The old app has no logs at all, in fact. The new app shows `2017-09-20T13:41:04.241411+00:00 shinyapps[50858]` as the final time logs were written.

I recently switched R versions (to 3.4.1) and updated all packages, including installing shiny, rsconnect, and DT from github. I can go roll these back one at a time.

Any thoughts? Is this a widespread issue, possibly?

Apologies for mentioning this in several comments and then also posting it here.

Thanks much,
Scott

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: shiny app disconnects from server; no logs
parts:
There is a known issue with R 3.4.x and Java on shinyapps.io that requires either rolling back to R 3.3.x or to place options(java.parameters = "-Xss2048k") ahead anything that causes java to start.

It appears you might be using xlsx which is known to trigger this issue.

Hope that helps!
